method: Balanced domain-disjoint 16000/4000/4000 partitions, all prior evaluations including ALL rejected v1 domains excluded. Source label 0=phishing,1=legitimate inverted to supervised target 1=phishing. Test sealed before training; labels historically assigned, no websites visited. Training/validation also use both schemes and www/non-www label-preserving synthetics to address source formatting bias; none added to final external test.
